articles.title: “Pick anyone from your party, step aside”: Owaisi dares Akhilesh Yadav to name Muslim CM face, recalls Muzaffarnagar riots
articles.description: "Akhilesh Yadav should go ahead, name one! Pick anyone from your party and step aside to let them lead. Who is stopping you? You were the Chief Minister for so many years, and your tenure ended in 2017. Now you talk about having a Muslim Chief Minister? Take a look at yourself in the mirror! Remember the Muzaffarnagar incident? More than 50,000 people were left homeless. How can you even talk about 'safety'?" Owaisi said.

articles.description: Bangladesh MP Nusrat Tabassum has alleged that petrol bombs were thrown at her village home in Kushtia. articles.title: Fires erupt, storefronts smashed as massive strike sparks riots across Spain
